caption:
The biggest AI stories of the week:
Anthropic's filing showed $17 billion in quarterly revenue and an operating loss.
The same filing warned that self-building AI may be close.
Apple opened Siri AI to every app developer.
OpenAI said ChatGPT now gets about one search for every five on Google.
AI stocks sank after the midterms, with the Nasdaq down 5% by late morning on November 5.
OpenAI raised $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation.

Which story mattered most to you?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: Fortune, TechCrunch, 9to5Mac, 9to5Google, AP, Reuters · Photos: AP, Reuters, Getty Images, 9to5Mac
threads_text: This week Anthropic showed $17 billion in quarterly revenue and still lost money, AI stocks got hammered after the midterms, and OpenAI raised $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation. Apple also opened Siri AI to every app. Which of these will still matter a year from now?

slides.headline: Anthropic made $17 billion and still lost money, Wall Street panicked: *the week in AI*

slides.heading: *$17 billion*, still a loss
paras: Anthropic's updated IPO filing shows $17 billion in revenue for July to September, up from $11.6 billion the quarter before.
Costs jumped to $17.5 billion, so it swung to a $567 million operating loss.

slides.heading: Self-building AI *may be close*
paras: The same filing says Anthropic's internal estimates show it may imminently meet a key safety threshold: AI that dramatically speeds up AI progress.
It says none of its models has crossed that line yet.

slides.heading: Siri AI opens to *every app*
paras: On November 3, Apple opened its Siri AI developer preview to all developers in the iOS 27.3 betas.
Apps can teach Siri multi-step jobs. Customers get the new app features in a few months.

slides.heading: ChatGPT gets *1 in 5*
paras: ChatGPT's search volume is now roughly one fifth of Google's, OpenAI's Adam Fry said.
He also said weekly users grew from 1 billion to 1.2 billion in 60 days.

slides.heading: AI stocks *crushed*
paras: By 11 a.m. New York time on November 5, the Nasdaq was down 5% as AI stocks sank after Democrats' midterm gains, AP reported.

slides.heading: OpenAI at *$1.25 trillion*
paras: OpenAI raised $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, Reuters reported on November 6, citing Bloomberg News.
The money is the first part of a larger funding round.

slides.hook: Follow for one clear recap of the biggest AI stories every Sunday.
